enVersion: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.he: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הוֹדוּ לַיהֹוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
enLines: Hallelujah. O give thanks unto the LORD; for He is good; for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: מִי יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹת יְהֹוָה יַשְׁמִיעַ כׇּל תְּהִלָּתוֹ
enLines: Who can express the mighty acts of the LORD, or make all His praise to be heard?

verses.he: אַשְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁפָּט עֹשֵׂה צְדָקָה בְכׇל עֵת
enLines: Happy are they that keep justice, that do righteousness at all times.

verses.he: זׇכְרֵנִי יְהֹוָה בִּרְצוֹן עַמֶּךָ פׇּקְדֵנִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ
enLines: Remember me, O LORD, when Thou favourest Thy people; O think of me at Thy salvation;

verses.he: לִרְאוֹת בְּטוֹבַת בְּחִירֶיךָ לִשְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַת גּוֹיֶךָ לְהִתְהַלֵּל עִם נַחֲלָתֶךָ
enLines: That I may behold the prosperity of Thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Thy nation, that I may glory with Thine inheritance.

verses.he: חָטָאנוּ עִם אֲבוֹתֵינוּ הֶעֱוִינוּ הִרְשָׁעְנוּ
enLines: We have sinned with our fathers, we have done iniquitously, we have dealt wickedly.

verses.he: אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְמִצְרַיִם לֹא הִשְׂכִּילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ לֹא זָכְרוּ אֶת רֹב חֲסָדֶיךָ וַיַּמְרוּ עַל יָם בְּיַם סוּף
enLines: Our fathers in Egypt gave no heed unto Thy wonders; they remembered not the multitude of Thy mercies; but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

verses.he: וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ לְהוֹדִיעַ אֶת גְּבוּרָתוֹ
enLines: Nevertheless He saved them for His name's sake, that He might make His mighty power to be known.

verses.he: וַיִּגְעַר בְּיַם סוּף וַיֶּחֱרָב וַיּוֹלִיכֵם בַּתְּהֹמוֹת כַּמִּדְבָּר
enLines: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up; and He led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.

verses.he: וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּד שׂוֹנֵא וַיִּגְאָלֵם מִיַּד אוֹיֵב
enLines: And He saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.he: וַיְכַסּוּ מַיִם צָרֵיהֶם אֶחָד מֵהֶם לֹא נוֹתָר
enLines: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.

verses.he: וַיַּאֲמִינוּ בִדְבָרָיו יָשִׁירוּ תְּהִלָּתוֹ
enLines: Then believed they His words; They sang His praise.

verses.he: מִהֲרוּ שָׁכְחוּ מַעֲשָׂיו לֹא חִכּוּ לַעֲצָתוֹ
enLines: They soon forgot His works; They waited not for His counsel;

verses.he: וַיִּתְאַוּוּ תַאֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיְנַסּוּ אֵל בִּישִׁימוֹן
enLines: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tried God in the desert.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָם וַיְשַׁלַּח רָזוֹן בְּנַפְשָׁם
enLines: And He gave them their request; But sent leanness into their soul.

verses.he: וַיְקַנְאוּ לְמֹשֶׁה בַּמַּחֲנֶה לְאַהֲרֹן קְדוֹשׁ יְהֹוָה
enLines: They were jealous also of Moses in the camp, And of Aaron the holy one of the LORD.

verses.he: תִּפְתַּח אֶרֶץ וַתִּבְלַע דָּתָן וַתְּכַס עַל עֲדַת אֲבִירָם
enLines: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.

verses.he: וַתִּבְעַר אֵשׁ בַּעֲדָתָם לֶהָבָה תְּלַהֵט רְשָׁעִים
enLines: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.

verses.he: יַעֲשׂוּ עֵגֶל בְּחֹרֵב וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְמַסֵּכָה
enLines: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.

verses.he: וַיָּמִירוּ אֶת כְּבוֹדָם בְּתַבְנִית שׁוֹר אֹכֵל עֵשֶׂב
enLines: Thus they exchanged their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.

verses.he: שָׁכְחוּ אֵל מוֹשִׁיעָם עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת בְּמִצְרָיִם
enLines: They forgot God their saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt;

verses.he: נִפְלָאוֹת בְּאֶרֶץ חָם נוֹרָאוֹת עַל יַם סוּף
enLines: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, Terrible things by the Red Sea.

verses.he: וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַשְׁמִידָם לוּלֵי מֹשֶׁה בְחִירוֹ עָמַד בַּפֶּרֶץ לְפָנָיו לְהָשִׁיב חֲמָתוֹ מֵהַשְׁחִית
enLines: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, Had not Moses His chosen stood before Him in the breach, To turn back His wrath, lest He should destroy them.

verses.he: וַיִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶרֶץ חֶמְדָּה לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ לִדְבָרוֹ
enLines: Moreover, they scorned the desirable land, They believed not His word;

verses.he: וַיֵּרָגְנוּ בְאׇהֳלֵיהֶם לֹא שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה
enLines: And they murmured in their tents, They hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.

verses.he: וַיִּשָּׂא יָדוֹ לָהֶם לְהַפִּיל אוֹתָם בַּמִּדְבָּר
enLines: Therefore He swore concerning them, That He would overthrow them in the wilderness;

verses.he: וּלְהַפִּיל זַרְעָם בַּגּוֹיִם וּלְזָרוֹתָם בָּאֲרָצוֹת
enLines: And that He would cast out their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.

verses.he: וַיִּצָּמְדוּ לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיֹּאכְלוּ זִבְחֵי מֵתִים
enLines: They joined themselves also unto Baal of Peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.he: וַיַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַעַלְלֵיהֶם וַתִּפְרׇץ בָּם מַגֵּפָה
enLines: Thus they provoked Him with their doings, And the plague broke in upon them.

verses.he: וַיַּעֲמֹד פִּינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּל וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה
enLines: Then stood up Phinehas, and wrought judgment, And so the plague was stayed.

verses.he: וַתֵּחָשֶׁב לוֹ לִצְדָקָה לְדֹר וָדֹר עַד עוֹלָם
enLines: And that was counted unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for ever.

verses.he: וַיַּקְצִיפוּ עַל מֵי מְרִיבָה וַיֵּרַע לְמֹשֶׁה בַּעֲבוּרָם
enLines: They angered Him also at the waters of Meribah, And it went ill with Moses because of them;

verses.he: כִּי הִמְרוּ אֶת רוּחוֹ וַיְבַטֵּא בִּשְׂפָתָיו
enLines: For they embittered his spirit, And he spoke rashly with his lips.

verses.he: לֹא הִשְׁמִידוּ אֶת הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהֹוָה לָהֶם
enLines: They did not destroy the peoples, As the LORD commanded them;

verses.he: וַיִּתְעָרְבוּ בַגּוֹיִם וַיִּלְמְדוּ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם
enLines: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works;

verses.he: וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּהְיוּ לָהֶם לְמוֹקֵשׁ
enLines: And they served their idols, Which became a snare unto them;

verses.he: וַיִּזְבְּחוּ אֶת בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם לַשֵּׁדִים
enLines: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ דָם נָקִי דַּם בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר זִבְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּי כְנָעַן וַתֶּחֱנַף הָאָרֶץ בַּדָּמִים
enLines: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.

verses.he: וַיִּטְמְאוּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם וַיִּזְנוּ בְּמַעַלְלֵיהֶם
enLines: Thus were they defiled with their works, And went astray in their doings.

verses.he: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהֹוָה בְּעַמּוֹ וַיְתָעֵב אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ
enLines: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against His people, And He abhorred His inheritance.

verses.he: וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד גּוֹיִם וַיִּמְשְׁלוּ בָהֶם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶם
enLines: And He gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.

verses.he: וַיִּלְחָצוּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶם וַיִּכָּנְעוּ תַּחַת יָדָם
enLines: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were subdued under their hand.

verses.he: פְּעָמִים רַבּוֹת יַצִּילֵם וְהֵמָּה יַמְרוּ בַעֲצָתָם וַיָּמֹכּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם
enLines: Many times did He deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And sank low through their iniquity.

verses.he: וַיַּרְא בַּצַּר לָהֶם בְּשׇׁמְעוֹ אֶת רִנָּתָם
enLines: Nevertheless He looked upon their distress, When He heard their cry;

verses.he: וַיִּזְכֹּר לָהֶם בְּרִיתוֹ וַיִּנָּחֵם כְּרֹב חֲסָדָו
enLines: And He remembered for them His covenant, And repented according to the multitude of His mercies.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּן אוֹתָם לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי כׇּל שׁוֹבֵיהֶם
enLines: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.

verses.he: הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ מִן הַגּוֹיִם לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם קׇדְשֶׁךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּחַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶךָ
enLines: Save us, O LORD our God, And gather us from among the nations, That we may give thanks unto Thy holy name, That we may triumph in Thy praise.

verses.he: בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם וְאָמַר כׇּל הָעָם אָמֵן הַלְלוּ יָהּ
enLines: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting, and let all the people say: 'Amen.' Hallelujah.
